## 1. Professional Background

Atharva Mahamuni is an Android software engineer specializing in enterprise-grade, high-reliability mobile and embedded systems. With over four years of dedicated Android engineering experience, Atharva designs and delivers scalable Android software from low-level media playback and hardware abstraction up to fluid, accessible Jetpack Compose user interfaces.

His primary domain focus spans:
1. **In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) Systems**: Seat-back touchscreens, Media3/ExoPlayer video pipelines, hardware media decoders, airline fleet deployments.
2. **Clean Architecture in Android**: Unidirectional data flow, pure Kotlin domain layers, dependency inversion via Dagger Hilt, and repository caching patterns.
3. **Financial & High-Security Applications**: Biometric authentication, hardware-backed Android Keystore cryptography, Baseline Profiles for sub-second startup times, performance testing infrastructure for the National Stock Exchange of India.
4. **Agentic Coding & Web Tooling**: Creator of ToyTools (https://toytoolsapp.com) and Online Slug Generator (https://onlinesluggenerator.com).

---

## 2. Detailed Work History

### Panasonic Avionics Corporation (Pune, India)
- **Roles**:
  - Member of Technical Staff 2 (MTS-2), Android Developer (Jul 2026 – Present)
  - Member of Technical Staff 1 (MTS-1), Android Developer (Jan 2025 – Jul 2026)
- **Engineering Contributions**:
  - Led the development of seat-back Android in-flight entertainment software operating across an active commercial fleet of 10 premium aircraft.
  - Architected media playback systems utilizing Google AndroidX Media3 / ExoPlayer, managing video decoding, adaptive streaming, DRM licensing, and audio routing.
  - Developed a unified, multi-module Android framework adhering to Clean Architecture and SOLID principles, shared across 3 distinct Panasonic Avionics IFE product lines.
  - Managed build engineering and release automation with Gradle Kotlin DSL, Version Catalogs, build flavors, ProGuard/R8 shrinking, Jenkins, and GitLab CI pipelines.

### Capgemini (Pune, India) — Client: National Stock Exchange (NSE)
- **Role**: Associate Consultant, Android Developer (Oct 2022 – Jan 2025)
- **Engineering Contributions**:
  - Built a secure Android client used by the National Stock Exchange to orchestrate large-scale load tests against trading and market data backend services via Apache JMeter wrappers.
  - Hardened application security using biometric authentication (BiometricPrompt) and hardware-backed key generation inside the Android Keystore.
  - Dramatically lowered cold start latency and frame jank by generating Jetpack Macrobenchmark Baseline Profiles and deferring dependency injection graph initialization.
  - Migrated legacy Java codebase to modern Kotlin, Coroutines, and MVVM architecture, increasing automated unit and UI test coverage (JUnit, Mockito, Espresso).

## 3. Technology Stack & Proficiency

- **Programming Languages**: Kotlin (expert), Java (proficient), TypeScript (proficient), SQL.
- **Android Technologies**: Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, StateFlow, Coroutines, Room DB, WorkManager, ExoPlayer / Media3, DataStore, Dagger Hilt, Navigation Component, Baseline Profiles.
- **Architecture**: Clean Architecture, Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM), Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF), Repository Pattern, Multi-Module Gradle projects.
- **Testing & Quality**: JUnit 4/5, Mockito, MockK, Robolectric, Espresso, Compose UI Testing, LeakCanary, Firebase Crashlytics.
- **Build & CI/CD**: Gradle Kotlin DSL, Version Catalogs (`libs.versions.toml`), ProGuard/R8, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Fastlane.

3. **IoT Robot Controller**:
   - Hardware robotics controller app communicating over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) with NodeMCU microcontrollers.

4. **Spotify Full-Stack App**:
   - Full-stack music streaming simulation with decoupled web frontend, Node.js REST API backend, and MySQL database.
